From \(d=0\): \(|-3m-n+2|=0\), so
\[
3m+n=2.
\]
Minimize
\[
\frac1m+\frac3n
\]
with \(m,n>0\) and \(3m+n=2\).

By Cauchy,
\[
\left(\frac1m+\frac3n\right)(3m+n)\ge (\sqrt3+\sqrt3)^2=12.
\]
Since \(3m+n=2\),
\[
\frac1m+\frac3n \ge 6.
\]
Equality occurs at \(m=\frac13,\ n=1\).

\[
\boxed{6}
\]
